findings.evidence: grep of the file: no `FG`, no `TopologicalSpace M`, no `.topology` declaration; only `powSmulFamily*` lemmas and `SubmodulesBasis` at line 212.
findings.fix: Retitle to what is delivered, e.g. "# The `ϖⁿ • M₀` submodules basis on a module over a Tate ring", and rename the file accordingly (e.g. `PowSmulBasis.lean`).
findings.issue: The file name (`FGModuleTopology.lean`) and the `#` title ("The topology induced by …") promise finite generation and a topology; the docstring itself then denies both — line 22-23 "Neither the uniqueness nor the identification is proved below, so nothing here may be called *the* canonical topology yet" and line 25-26 "Remark 6.19 assumes `A` noetherian and `M₀` finitely generated; no declaration below uses either". No declaration in the file constructs a topology or mentions `Submodule.FG`.

findings.fix: Add a `## Main definitions` bullet for `TauCeti.Huber.PairOfDefinition.powSmulFamily` and a `## Main results` bullet for `powSmulFamily_smul`.
findings.issue: `powSmulFamily` (line 74) is the file's only definition and the object every other declaration is about, but the module docstring has no `## Main definitions` section and does not list it; `powSmulFamily_smul` (line 170), the `smul` half that carries the whole construction, is likewise absent from `## Main results`.

findings.evidence: Line 74-76: `def powSmulFamily (P : PairOfDefinition A) {s : A} (hs0 : s ∈ P.ringOfDefinition) …`; `IsPseudoUniformizer` appears first at line 170.
findings.fix: State the definition at its real generality: "for any `s ∈ A₀`, the `A₀`-submodules `sⁿ • M₀` of `M`; written `ϖⁿ • M₀` below because the intended `s` is a pseudouniformiser".
findings.issue: The docstring of `powSmulFamily` describes the family only as `ϖⁿ • M₀` with `ϖ` a pseudouniformiser, but the definition takes an arbitrary `s : A` with `s ∈ P.ringOfDefinition` — no unit and no topological-nilpotence hypothesis. A reader of the public signature cannot tell what `s`, `hs0` and `n` are or that the definition is available for any element of `A₀`. Same mismatch in `powSmulFamily_def` (line 79) and `mem_powSmulFamily` (line 87), which also speak only of `ϖ`.

summary: Cross-references and result docstrings are accurate, but the file name and module-docstring title advertise a finitely-generated-module topology that the file explicitly disclaims delivering, and the file's only definition is neither listed in the module docstring nor documented at its actual generality.
